decisions.reason: Premium support embodies the firm's publicly announced promise of round-the-clock expert service for agencies, so it is central to its identity and cheap to sustain.
The version management tool builds on the core platform and reflects sunk in-house development effort and the stated aim of reducing recurring operational work, so management will persist with it.

Although distant from the core offer, the contract tool was given its own page and developed as a line of several models, and its GDPR-related relevance lets management attribute weak results to temporary market conditions, so it keeps it for now despite a substantial risk of dropping.
Scalable agency hosting was featured on the home page and sits at the heart of the firm's agency-focused strategy, making it highly visible and heavily committed.
